title: Casa Rosado Rincon 1BR Rayo Suite Mountain 2 Pools
description: Casa Rosado Rincon Boutique Hotel Rayo Suite is A Modern One Bedroom that offers a Queen Size Bed, Full Kitchen, Cooking Essentials, Livingroom, AC, WIFI, BBQ Grill, Two Pools, Outdoor Shower, Outdoor Dinning Area, Sun Longe Chairs, Beach Essentials & Solar Panels for peace of mind. Just 5 minutes to the Town with Restaurants, Bars and Best Surfing Beaches in Puerto Rico. Perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape while enjoying the vibrant culture and natural beauty of the island.The spaceNestled is the heart of Rincon, where breathtaking mountains and valley views awaits you. This exquisite property is perfect for those seeking a tranquil escape while enjoying the vibrant culture and natural beauty of the island. Relax by our private beautiful Kio Pond and Garden while being greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere with two beautiful pools. Just five minutes from Pueblo de Rincon & All Surfing Beaches. This property features four units, The Rayo Suite, Surfer Suite, Gallo Suite & Wave Suite. Perfect for Family Reunions, Wedding & Birthdays. Property is ideal for Couples & Adults Only. All common areas are shared with all units and guest. It may not be suitable for children under 14 years of age.Guest accessGuests are welcomed to enjoy the entire property with both Pools, Lounge Chairs, BBQ Grills, & beautiful Kio Fish Pond area. Each Units does offer their own private area for your access only. For Security purposes cameras are in the pool and parking areas. Please do not access unauthorized areas marked. NO OUTSIDE GUEST.Other things to noteThis property is not suitable for children under 14. (Preferably) for Adults Only. Puerto Rico has a power grid issue and power outage are common, but we are equipped with Solar Panels with Tesla batteries, so you can enjoy your vacation without the power issues. PLEASE note that during power grid outage less power has to be consumed so please leaving only one AC on at 75 degrees & do not use hot water to preserve power during the outage. Washer & Dryer are available free to guest with a reservation of 4 or More Days or applied $20 fee per stay which includes detergent for guests that are staying less than 4 daysWe are situated at the westernmost point of the island. We are 2.5 hours from the San Juan Airport (SJU), 30 minutes from both Aguadilla Airport (BQN) & Mayaguez Airport (MAZ), and 1.5 hours from Ponce Airport (PSE) airport. To avoid the drive from San Juan, there is a Cape Air flight that goes directly multiple times a day from SJU to MAZ Scooter rental available on site. Contact us directly as our guests get 20% off. This is the best way to enjoy Thursday Night Art Feast with zero parking issues or see our beautiful sunsets at the Light House.

description: Endless Ocean Views is a 3 story well built home perched high on the top of La Joya hill surrounded by palm trees,tropical forest, fruit trees(banana, mango,almond,avocado,carambola,tamarindo) and ocean vistas. This 2 bed/1 bath apartment has incredible ocean and valley views. We are 7/10th of mi up the hill from beautiful Tres Palmas Marine Reserve. For those looking for a great location close to everything yet quiet and private as this house sits on a full 8 acres... we invite you to stay!The spaceBuilt and designed by the owner we take great pleasure and joy in sharing our home on the enchanted Island of Puerto Rico.On the ground level is a shared laundry area with a full washer and dryer. Enjoy the shared outdoor shower, great for washing a day's worth of sand off. This ground level apartment features a wrap around deck which is a delightful outdoor space for dining, relaxing, watching the sun and moon gaze over the ocean and simply slowing down. Step inside to our newly updated and renovated space offering an open floor plan with a fully equipt kitchen and comfortably appointed living room great after a hard day at the beach. The kitchen has a table for 4 for inside dining and on the deck offers another table for 6 for outside dining. The living room has a blend of comfortable couch and recliners, with Wifi and flat screen tv. Both spacious bedrooms are air conditioned with a comfortable queen sized bed and a single bed in each room. There is also a full size bathroom with a full sized tiled shower.Guest accessEntire ground level apartmentOther things to noteWe have a large generator and 1200 gallons of back up water in our cisterns. When our power and water go out you wont even know it happened! Our generator runs a self-test once a week-every Monday at 9 am for approximately ten minutes. This test will assure it is ready if you ever need it.We also supply sheets and towels for your convenience.Please no smoking inside the house.No PetsAge requirement-25 or older

title: Tamboo Terrace Suite 7 (Beach Access On Site)
description: We are on the beach where you should be... This cozy apartment is the perfect getaway for weekends stays or long term rental. Featuring a living room area equipped with a Smart TV with access to your favorite streaming channel accounts. Adjoined with a fully equipped kitchenette to cook your favorite meals, private balcony to enjoy the ocean breeze, a separate room with two queen beds and a private bathroom. Indulge in the shared sun terrace overlooking the ocean or the refreshing shared pool.The spaceTamboo Beside The Pointe is a beachfront hotel, that means spending the day at the beautiful Sandy Beach and then relaxing on the terrace while enjoying the sunset. Our seaside grill restaurant is located onsite as well as our #1 Beach Bar in The Caribbean (USA Today 2018) where guests can unwind with a drink and enjoy the fresh ocean air. Restaurant operating schedule is Thursday to Monday from 12pm-10pm on a walk-in basis only with last seating for dinner at 9pm.We have a power generator and a water cistern in case of electricity or water failure.Guest access-Private Balcony inside the apartment-Private sun terrace with ocean views shared with two other suites (if occupied)-Shared Pool-Exclusive beach access to Sandy BeachOther things to note*PLEASE NOTE that Airbnb only charges guests 7% of occupancy taxes in the reservation. Since Tamboo is hotel endorsed by the Puerto Rico Tourism Company, we are required to charge 9% occupancy taxes. Therefore, we are responsible to charge the difference of 2% on your reservation. This will be payable after check in when you register at our hotel. If you would like to know the total amount to be paid at check in beforehand, please send us a message.***Our on site restaurant works on a walk in basis and is open Thursday to Monday from 12PM-9PM. Last seating is at 8PM.NOTE: September 2024 Restaurant Hours: Friday - Sunday from 12pm - 9pm. Last seating at 8pm, on a walk in basis.

description: One minute from the beach! Cute villa overlooking the ocean, very close to the best beaches, and high enough on the hill to enjoy great breeze and views all the way to Aguadilla Bay. Very private, quiet location on a small dead-end street. We have backup solar power and water tank.The spaceA fully equipped home, with fully equipped kitchen. The larger bedroom has one queen-sized bed. The second bedroom has bunk beds (lower bed is full, top is twin). One full bathroom plus an outdoor shower. A large patio with outdoor dining set, lounge chair, and coconut trees overlooking the ocean. Enough space to park inside the property.The home has a backup solar power system that will automatically turn on whenever there is a power outage. Power outages are frequent in Rincon, but they usually only last a few hours. Whenever the home is running on solar power, the a/c's will not be available, but there are fans throughout the entire home. Heat-generating appliances (stove, oven, etc.) will also not be available, but we do offer a small gas stove you can use. The refrigerator and everything else in the home will work during a power outage as long as the batteries are not depleted.Guest accessIMPORTANT: Guests must fully read and agree with all House Rules (found under Guest Manual in reservation details).The kitchen is fully equipped with refrigerator, stove with full-size oven, microwave oven, convection/toaster oven, crock pot, rice cooker, coffee maker, blender, and more.Guests can use the entire house and the entire outdoor area. There is a separate storage area on one side of the house where I keep my personal belongings, this area will be locked.Other things to noteThere is a separate storage space on the side of the house that is not included as part of the rental. This space connects to the closet in the master bedroom, but the connecting door will remain locked during rentals.

description: The Avocado Suite features 2 bedroms, a private kitchen & 1 bath. The apartment is located on the 2nd floor of a home with 3 other rental units, 1 next door and 2 below. The rooftop deck is 1 floor up and is shared with all guests. The space is clean and bright, with beautiful views of the ocean in the backyard. Located right off of 413 in Puntas barrio.The spaceThe Avocado Suite is a 2 bed, 1 bath apt. located on the 2nd floor of the home with 3 other rental units. The space is clean and bright, with beautiful views of the ocean and the trees in the backyard. Located right off of 413 in Puntas barrio. This is a perfect room for 2-4 people and features 2 bedrooms with 3 queen beds, 1 full bathroom, full kitchen and spacious living room and dining area. Beautiful ocean views from the living room and 1st bedroom. *Please be sure to request the room with the exact number of guests. Although there are 3 beds, the guest limit is 4, sorry no exceptions. We welcome respectful adults looking for a calm & relaxing getaway. This is not a party house. We do not allow any outside visitors, gatherings or parties/events at the home.*You will need a car to get around Rincon. We do not have reliable public transportation and Uber does not operate in this area. *We have solar that runs that whole house. We do switch over to the grid overnight. If we should lose power to the grid overnight, we will lose the air conditioners until we start making power again in the morning. In very rare cases we may go a few hours without power. We ask for your patience and understanding if power should go out during your stay. It is completely out of our control and we’ll do our best to keep you comfortable. Thank you!*Lastly, while we do have hot water, the hot water heaters are on-demand propane heaters and they are extremely finicky! Sometimes you have to turn water off and on to get the hot water to kick back on. Please be sure you’re ok with this before booking.Guest accessGuests have access to all outdoor areas including our rooftop terrace. This rooftop area is a hidden gem and always takes people by surprise! Panoramic views of the ocean for whale watching, grilling out or just napping in the hammock.Other things to note*Holiday reservations are non-refundable.*PLEASE NOTE! If you are flying in and out of Aguadilla, please plan accordingly!!! For example if you are flying in and land at 2am on Saturday, you need to book Friday night in order to get into your room at that time. If you don't book the previous night, check in is 3pm or after on the date of your reservation, in this case, on Saturday. I am not able to hold the room for you to check in in the middle of the night/early morning unless you reserve the previous night.
amenities: 50 inch TV with Amazon Prime Video, Apple TV, Netflix
